run_selfplay_main: run the selfplay main entry point to train and evaluate meta-regret and regret matching agents
create_matrix_dataset: create a matrix dataset with a base payoff matrix, training batch count, and value range for randomization
train_meta_selfplay_agent: train a meta selfplay agent with repeats, training epochs, and a data loader for meta-regret matching
train_regret_matching_agent: train a regret matching agent with a specified number of actions and a data loader
evaluate_in_selfplay: evaluate two agents in selfplay against a payoff batch for a given number of steps
